duplication_analysis: REUSE is sufficient for crawler research, demand validation, supplier search, deterministic economics, evidence QA, and execution/recovery controls. EXTEND is required only for the unowned reconciliation loop. The extension must live within existing Run 004 and shared Run 008/Work Control patterns: read authoritative SourceMargin operational state, compare it with execution and durable-record checkpoints, fail closed on conflict or staleness, and emit a typed state receipt for Agent 000/Work Control. It must not create a new director, standalone state owner, alternate task system, duplicate database, or autonomous authority.
